# Caching.ai

> Caching.ai is a drop-in proxy for the Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini and Grok APIs that protects, warms, and measures your prompt cache — so the up-to-90% prompt-caching discount providers already offer actually shows up on your bill. Integration is a single base-URL swap; prompts and responses are never stored by default.

Key facts:
- What it does: cache analytics (real hit rate, dollars saved, dollars wasted), automatic cache_control breakpoint injection, cache-breaker detection (e.g. timestamps in system prompts), and a Cache Warmer that keeps provider prefix caches warm through idle gaps — only while it is economical.
- Measured results (10,000+ real billed API calls, method and raw logs public): 67% saved on sparse support traffic with 6–9 minute idle gaps; 89% saved on a 300-call shared-prefix batch; on GPT-5.6 (where SDK-default traffic gets 0% prefix hits) the proxy restores 97.8%+ hit rates. Latency is equal or better — a cache hit skips prompt prefill, so first tokens arrive sooner.
- Providers: Anthropic (auto cache_control + Cache Warmer + 5m/1h TTL Auto-Tune), OpenAI GPT-5.6+ (explicit cache breakpoint + stable prompt_cache_key), Gemini and Grok (metering, savings pricing, breaker warnings; Grok gets a stable cache-routing header).
- Pricing: performance-based — 20% of verified net savings (warming-ping costs subtracted), billed after each month closes; fees under $5/month are waived. Save nothing, pay nothing.
- Open source: the core proxy and console are Apache-2.0 — self-host with one `docker compose up`, or use the managed cloud.
- Privacy: prompt and response bodies are never stored by default; provider keys are encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM); the opt-in Cache Warmer stores an encrypted copy of the prompt prefix only because re-sending it is how the cache stays warm.

## Docs

- [Quickstart](https://caching.ai/docs): create a key, swap the base URL, done — with copy-paste recipes for Claude Code, Codex, Cline and other tools.
- [Agent setup guide](https://caching.ai/agent-setup.md): paste-into-your-coding-agent setup script with backups and verification.
